slot.brief: Two statements on disaccharide glycosidic linkage / reducing behaviour (e.g. sucrose vs maltose); pick correct option.

stem:
Consider the following statements about disaccharides.

Statement I: Cellobiose is a reducing sugar because its $\beta$-$(1\rightarrow4)$ linkage leaves an anomeric carbon free.

Statement II: Trehalose is a reducing sugar because its $\alpha,\alpha$-$(1\rightarrow1)$ linkage leaves one anomeric carbon free.

Choose the correct answer:
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct

verdicts.working: Cellobiose has one free anomeric carbon, so it is reducing. Trehalose’s α,α-(1→1) linkage uses both anomeric carbons, so it is nonreducing.

working:
Cellobiose: $\beta$-$(1\rightarrow4)$ linkage; one anomeric carbon remains free $\Rightarrow$ reducing.
Trehalose: $\alpha,\alpha$-$(1\rightarrow1)$ linkage uses both anomeric carbons $\Rightarrow$ non-reducing.
Thus, Statement I is correct and Statement II is incorrect.
